title: A Rainy Shopping Trip
setting: Sara's kitchen and a street near a small food shop.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a green jacket

sentences.en: Sara comes home from work and opens the fridge.
sentences.zh: 萨拉下班回家，打开了冰箱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat opens a fridge in her kitchen, still holding her bag.

sentences.en: She can see only one small potato.
sentences.scene_prompt: Inside a nearly empty fridge sits one small potato.

sentences.en: She writes a short shopping list.
sentences.zh: 她写了一张简短的购物清单。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat writes a list on a small notepad at the kitchen table.

sentences.en: Soon the sky is dark and grey.
sentences.zh: 不久，天空变得又暗又灰。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dark grey clouds fill the sky over a street, seen from a kitchen window.

sentences.en: "I hate rain," says Sara, and takes an umbrella.
sentences.zh: “我讨厌下雨。”萨拉说着，拿起了一把雨伞。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat frowns at the rain and picks up an umbrella by the door.

sentences.en: She walks around the corner in her coat.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat walks around a street corner under her umbrella in light rain.

sentences.en: After a minute, she meets Ivan by the shop.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她在商店旁遇见了伊万。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat meets Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a green jacket in front of a small food shop; they greet each other.

sentences.en: "Come for dinner at my house later," says Ivan.
sentences.zh: “晚点来我家吃晚饭吧。”伊万说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a tall man with short black hair and a green jacket smiles and invites Sara, a young woman with long brown hair and a blue coat, pointing down the street toward a house.
